blurb: 31st Street Harbor provides mooring and slip permits with fees based on boat length. They offer outdoor and indoor winter storage with power washing and optional shrink wrapping. Commercial permits are available with specific requirements including insurance and licenses.
extraNote: Deposit of $15 per foot of boat length required to apply for mooring · Auxiliary permits must be displayed while in the harbor
